summary: Integrate lmxxf 0.36 + 9/29 kernel/scheduling/C512-head-ViT into vendor and modules. Direct I/O and FRAME_STATS deferred as separate product batches. Experiments/docs excluded.
validation: Sources staged to c0a6196; local patches apply; native_frame_stats.h in manifest. Dual-arch modules rebuilt (30+30) and bound via -ModulesPath. LmxxfNrRuntime rebuilt; tests/lmxxf/run.cmd abi PASS (22 unittest OK). FMA numerical baseline intentionally changed (328e1081). GPU goldens and in-game validation still outstanding.

decisions.reason: Chase lmxxf 0.36 kernels/scheduling (9a82385f/328e1081/fcc11736/7aef4a8e/ea4c0ca0) and 9/29 production deep-layer opts (9880d030 C512 compact, 0c170973 head+ViT). Direct I/O (5515b102) and FRAME_STATS (21a3931d) sources landed for compile completeness but product wiring is deferred. 0.36 float FMA (328e1081) intentionally changes the numerical baseline. Upstream reports bit-stable for earlier opts, but FMA needs its own output-error record. Other 0.36/9-29 fusion and layout opts are compared against this FMA baseline.
decisions.evidence: Range 54e14de503431cd4536f8a7151b022af232178a9 -> c0a61968874e438ca3f887506f09c185ce378020. vendor diffs: hip recipes/kernels + c512_*.inc, hip_reference_network.h CompactC512Body/C512_COMPACT_QKV_ATTN/C512_HEAD_GROUP/ViT transposed score, native_game_rgb_input RedirectOutput/tiles_needed, native_hip_network direct_input, native_frame_stats.h added to manifest. Coverage: work/notes/2026-09-29-lmxxf-feature-coverage.md.
decisions.validation: Sync staged sources and reapplied local patches (reference-network, auto-white, r10g10b10a2, typeless-float16, codec-hue-safe-preexp). native_frame_stats.h added to manifest for the new include. Not yet: dual-arch module rebuild, FMA golden/error record, in-game smoke, Direct I/O history tests.
decisions.next_step: 1) Rebuild full gfx1200+gfx1201 module sets from staged hip sources (do not reuse stale hsaco). 2) Record FMA numerical delta separately from fusion opts. 3) Keep Direct I/O and FRAME_STATS default-off until their batches. 4) Run ABI/WARP/GPU and supported-tier/resize/history/zero-output validation; gfx1200 stays untested without hardware.
